text:
The Food, Drink, and Lodging table gives prices for food and a single night’s lodging. Prices for daily lodging and meals are included in your lifestyle’s expenses.

##### Food, Drink, and Lodging

| **Item** | **Cost** |
| Ale (mug) | 4 CP |
| Bread (loaf) | 2 CP |
| Cheese (wedge) | 1 SP |

*Inn Stay per Day*

| ↳ Squalid | 7 CP |
| ↳ Poor | 1 SP |
| ↳ Modest | 5 SP |
| **Item** | **Cost** |
| ↳ Comfortable | 8 SP |
| ↳ Wealthy | 2 GP |
| ↳ Aristocratic | 4 GP |

*Meal*

| ↳ Squalid | 1 CP |
| ↳ Poor | 2 CP |
| ↳ Modest | 1 SP |
